用法：ScreenSwitchCli.exe <命令>
  setup                             交互式设置：主屏、本机、另一台电脑、
                                    设备；写入 config.json 并重启托盘程序
  setup devices                     只改设备列表：改名、删除、添加
  status                            以 JSON 输出全部状态（给智能体用）
  detect [--main <型号>]            检测主屏、本机所接的输入口和屏幕组合
  ports                             主屏的各个输入口以及每个口接了什么（JSON）
  peer set|clear|test               另一台电脑（set --os --host --user [--name]）
  pubkey                            打印本机的 SSH 公钥（没有就生成一个）
  authorize "<密钥>"                授权另一台电脑的密钥（需要管理员）
  device add|rename|remove          接在其他输入口上的设备
  set <键> <值>                     owned-layout、auto-save、direct-take、hotkey、after-take
  autostart on|off                  登录时自动运行
  request give peer                 请正在运行的托盘程序把主屏切给另一台电脑
  request give code <n>             ……切给输入口编码为 n 的设备（十进制，必须在设备列表里）
  request give self                 ……或重新应用本机的布局
                                    （退出码 0 已接受，2 主屏不在本机，3 没有运行，1 目标有误 / 设备未知）
  request take                      另一台电脑要切回这里：立即恢复布局（退出码 0 成功，3 没有运行）
  request info                      打印本机的编码、名字和设备（一行，名字为 Base64）
  diag                              列出显示器并检查主显示器的 DDC/CI
  ddc-read                          读主显示器的输入源（VCP 0x60）
  ddc-write <十六进制>              切换主显示器的输入源
  layout-show                       当前的显示路径和模式
  layout-mode                       当前模式和排列签名（只读）
  layout-save                       把当前的扩展布局存为快照
  layout-take                       应用快照（扩展，两块屏）
  layout-take-main                  只留主屏（副屏关闭）
  layout-release                    把副屏的桌面克隆到两块屏上
  icon-dump <目录>                  把托盘图标写成 PNG 文件
  ui-dump <目录> [zh|en]            把菜单、设置窗口和向导画成 PNG 文件（演示数据）
column3:
usage: ScreenSwitchCli.exe <command>
  setup                             interactive setup: main screen, this computer, the other
                                    computer, devices; writes config.json and restarts the tray app
  setup devices                     only the device list: rename, delete, add
  status                            all state as JSON (for agents)
  detect [--main <model>]           detect the main screen, this computer's input and the screen combination
  ports                             the main screen's inputs and what is connected to each (JSON)
  peer set|clear|test               the other computer (set --os --host --user [--name])
  pubkey                            print this computer's SSH public key (creates one if missing)
  authorize "<key>"                 authorise the other computer's key (needs administrator)
  device add|rename|remove          devices on the other inputs
  set <key> <value>                 owned-layout, auto-save, direct-take, hotkey, after-take
  autostart on|off                  start at login
  request give peer                 ask the running tray app to switch the main screen to the other computer
  request give code <n>             ... to the device on input code n (decimal, must be in the device list)
  request give self                 ... or to re-apply this computer's layout
                                    (exit 0 accepted, 2 not owned, 3 not running, 1 bad target / unknown device)
  request take                      the other computer is about to switch here: restore the layout now (exit 0 ok, 3 not running)
  request info                      print this computer's code, name and devices (one line, names in Base64)
  diag                              list monitors and check DDC/CI on the main monitor
  ddc-read                          read the main monitor's input source (VCP 0x60)
  ddc-write <hex>                   switch the main monitor's input source
  layout-show                       active display paths and current mode
  layout-mode                       current mode and arrangement signatures (read-only)
  layout-save                       save the current extended layout as the snapshot
  layout-take                       apply the snapshot (extended, both screens)
  layout-take-main                  main screen only (secondary off)
  layout-release                    clone the secondary's desktop onto both screens
  icon-dump <dir>                   write the tray icons as PNG files
  ui-dump <dir> [zh|en]             draw the menu, settings and wizard to PNG files (demo data)
